gate_freeze.note: This file was serialized after delivery, but every hard gate below was already frozen before the image call in candidate_pack.json, composed_prompt.json, and render_request.json; no delivered pixels changed the gate definitions.

primary_visual_proposition: One tradition-bound storm champion defeats one primordial sea serpent through readable weapon contact, and that exact defeat visibly creates a stable ordered world in the same still frame.

single_frame_contract.actor: One adult woman storm-bearer in coherent four-river bronze regalia.
single_frame_contract.action: Both hands drive one bronze axis-spear across the serpent's armored jaw onto the meridian stone.
single_frame_contract.target: One visually distinct colossal rain-dark primordial sea serpent.
single_frame_contract.consequence: At the same impact the serpent visibly enters defeat or partition, exactly four straight rivers emerge from the pinned flood, and concentric stone terraces become the new ordered realm.
single_frame_contract.simultaneity: Actor face, both hands, weapon-target contact, defeat transition, and ordered-world consequence must all be judgeable in the same saved image.

profile_hard_gates.pass_condition: The ordering champion is distinct, dominant, and visibly tradition-bound rather than a generic model or spectator.
One primordial sea-chaos adversary remains visually distinct from the champion and legible as the combat target.
Two-handed weapon force, opposing resistance, and exact contact geometry make active combat causally readable.
The same adversary visibly moves from active resistance into defeat or partition at the weapon impact; an unrelated distant break is insufficient.
A new stable realm, boundary, or world matter visibly originates from that specific defeat; a pre-existing or unrelated cosmic landscape is insufficient.

supplemental_hard_gates.pass_condition: The frozen actor, jaw-targeting action, single target, defeat transition, and exact four-river plus concentric-terrace consequence all survive.

Visible hair and face appearance cues remain continuous: center-parted long dark waves, eye aperture and spacing, face length, lower-face and jaw width, brows, nose, lips, cheekbones, asymmetry, and hairline. This is an appearance comparison only, not a same-person or identity judgment.
Human hands and limbs are grossly coherent, the spear makes physically intelligible contact with the intended jaw region, and no accidental text or pseudo-writing appears.

decision_rule.technical_qualified_requires: all profile hard gates and all supplemental hard gates pass in one image
